{{Quote|Since Sy Myrth is largely self-sufficient and quite wealthy, I think the only thing the planet will "suffer" is being released from the burden of Republic taxation.|Brookish Boon|<ref name="AndoSecede">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref>}}

'''Brookish Boon''' was a [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] political commentator who hosted [[Local day/Legends|morning]] broadcasts. An opinionated com-host, he was featured on the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] several times for his opinions on the secession of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] and [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the idea of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] being a shadow government, and a [[Refugee Relief Movement fundraiser|fundraiser]] held on the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] for the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he visited the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he was based during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. 

==Biography==
===Morning broadcasting===
{{Quote|The committee is just as the Supreme Chancellor said it is, a steering committee to help in upcoming negotiations with the Separatists. It's not much of a shadow government if someone as myopic as Mr. Boon can find it,|Kinman Doriama on Brookish Boon's thoughts on the Loyalist Committee|<ref name="BoonLoyalists" />}}
[[File:QuantillCity-HoloNetNewsVol531-45.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Brookish Boon commented on the secession of Ando (pictured).]]
Brookish Boon was a [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] com-host<ref name="BoonLoyalists" /> and political commentator whose [[Local day/Legends|morning]] broadcasts<ref name="AndoSecede" /> rivaled the morning show ''[[Amberdawn]]''<ref name="BoonLoyalists" /> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="AndoSecede" /> In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Date1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}} is set on the date 13:2:28, which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Secession of Ando|Ando]] and [[Secession of Sy Myrth|Sy Myrth]] seceded from the reigning [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During a morning broadcast on the day of the secessions, Boon opined that Sy Myrth would not suffer from its release of Republic taxation, which he described as a burden. The [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] included Boon's statement in their coverage of the event on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:2:28.<ref name="AndoSecede" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_5.html|Boon Calls Loyalists a Shadow Government}} is set on the date 13:4:25, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Boon was later mentioned by HoloNet News on the date 13:4:25, reporting out of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on<ref name="BoonLoyalists" /> the planet<ref name="VD" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], on his controversial accusation of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] operating as a shadow government running outside the control of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. An aide of Palpatine's, [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], discussed the accusation on ''Amberdawn'', where he stated that the Committee was not a shadow government if someone as myopic as Boon could find it.<ref name="BoonLoyalists" /> 

===Galas and operas===
A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] before a [[Refugee Relief Movement fundraiser|gala]] held on<ref name="HNN3">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_4.html|RRM Fundraiser a Huge Success}}</ref> the planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] fundraising for the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], Boon criticized the upcoming event as self-congratulatory and over-expensive for an event held for poor individuals. After the gala, HoloNet News reported on it and speculated that [[Kaysil Verwood]], the spokesperson for the relief movement, had spoken on Boon's comments at the event. Verwood stated that cynics were critical of the wealthy, but in his opinion, they cared for the low-income.<ref name="HNN3" />

[[File:BrookishBoon-ROTS.png|thumb|right|300px|Brookish Boon was a visitor of the Galaxies Opera House.]]
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> which had broken out between the Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="VD" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Boon was based on Coruscant.<ref name="TCSWE" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Sy Myrth visited<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="VD" /> in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|acros_krik|Acros-Krik}}</ref> As a performance of the ballet ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''<ref name="Souvenir">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: Official Episode III Souvenir Movie Guide]]''</ref> occurred, Boon stood near the steps of the opera house next to another individual as the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran up the stairs to meet with Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" /> While Boon visited, he kept a secret recording device concealed in his [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="VD" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Does anyone else find this moronic? Hey, let's help the poor by spending how-many-thousands of credits in a big self-congratulatory party!|Brookish Boon criticizes the fundraiser for the Refugee Relief Movement|<ref name="HNN3" />}}
Boon was a commentator<ref name="TCSWE" /> who was criticized by Kinman Doriana<ref name="BoonLoyalists" /> and possibly by Kaysil Verwood for the opinions he held.<ref name="HNN3" /><ref name="BoonLoyalists" /> The cantankerous and opinionated Sy Myrth<ref name="TCSWE" /> portrayed himself as such against government corruption, though he too benefited from the graft and amenities he targeted others for.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> Boon had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin, red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="VD" />

==Equipment==
While visiting the Galaxies Opera House, Boon kept under his purple Sy Myrthian mantilla a secret recording device.<ref name="VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brookish Boon was first mentioned in "Ando, Sy Myrth Secede," an article included in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45]]'', on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|Holonet News]] website.<ref name="AndoSecede" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and was published on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref> Boon was first pictured&mdash;in set photos for the then upcoming [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]&mdash;in the "[[Prequel Update]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 79|seventy-ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name=Insider79">{{InsiderCite|79|Prequel Update}}</ref> available for subscribers on [[November 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20041116.html|text=Wookiees Roar Triumphant in ''Star Wars Insider'' #79}}</ref>

In the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a Sy Myrthian character who appeared fleetingly in ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' was identified as "Brookish Boone." According to that book, "Brookish Boone" attended the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] performance of [[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], with a secret recording device hidden beneath her mantilla.<ref name="ROSV">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
